title: Open source licences
summary: Lists every open source component in the app with its licence, and the app's own licence with the app store permission (ADR 0144). A tap shows the full licence text.

name.description: The component name, for example matrix-rust-sdk or Phosphor.

licence.description: The SPDX id, for example Apache-2.0 or MIT.

text.description: The full licence text with the copyright lines.

components.description: Bipe first (AGPL-3.0-only with the app store permission), then the dependencies by name.

selected.description: The component whose text is open.

select.effect: Shows the full licence text of that component.

back.effect: Closes the text, or the screen.

notes: The list is made at build time from the dependency list that the licence check in CI already reads (plan section 2: allowed Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD, ISC, MPL-2.0). Never typed by hand.
No Element component may appear: the dependency deny-list in CI fails first (plan section 1).
Component names and licence texts are not translated.
